SELECT
    a.END_DATE AS `报告期`,
    a.SEC_CSNAME AS `股票简称`,
    a.COMB_SYMBOL AS `股票代码`,
    ROUND(
        (
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_ASIA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_OCEANIA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_EU_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_NON_EU_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_AFRICA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_MID_EAST_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_LATIN_AMERICA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_NORTH_AMERICA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_AMERICA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_JAPAN_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_KOREA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_TW_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_RUSSIA_CNY,0)
        ) / NULLIF(
            IFNULL(
                (
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_ASIA_CNY,0) +
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_OCEANIA_CNY,0) +
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_EU_CNY,0) +
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_NON_EU_CNY,0) +
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_AFRICA_CNY,0) +
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_MID_EAST_CNY,0) +
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_LATIN_AMERICA_CNY,0) +
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_NORTH_AMERICA_CNY,0) +
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_AMERICA_CNY,0) +
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_JAPAN_CNY,0) +
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_KOREA_CNY,0) +
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_TW_CNY,0) +
                    IFNULL(a.REVENUE_RUSSIA_CNY,0)
                ) + IFNULL(b.INCOME,0)
            ,0)
        ,0) * 100, 2
    ) AS `2024年海外营业收入占总营收比重(%)`,
    ROUND(
        (
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_ASIA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_OCEANIA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_EU_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_NON_EU_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_AFRICA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_MID_EAST_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_LATIN_AMERICA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_NORTH_AMERICA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_AMERICA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_JAPAN_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_KOREA_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_TW_CNY,0) +
            IFNULL(a.REVENUE_RUSSIA_CNY,0)
        ) / 10000, 3
    ) AS `2024年海外营业收入(亿元)`,
    ROUND(
        IFNULL(
            (
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_ASIA_CNY,0) +
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_OCEANIA_CNY,0) +
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_EU_CNY,0) +
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_NON_EU_CNY,0) +
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_AFRICA_CNY,0) +
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_MID_EAST_CNY,0) +
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_LATIN_AMERICA_CNY,0) +
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_NORTH_AMERICA_CNY,0) +
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_AMERICA_CNY,0) +
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_JAPAN_CNY,0) +
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_KOREA_CNY,0) +
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_TW_CNY,0) +
                IFNULL(a.REVENUE_RUSSIA_CNY,0)
            ) + IFNULL(b.INCOME,0)
        ,0) / 10000, 3
    ) AS `2024年总营业收入(亿元)`
FROM
    ASTK_REVENUE_OVERSEAS a
LEFT JOIN
    STK_PRI_INCOME_DISTRICT b
    ON a.COMCODE = b.COMCODE AND b.ITEM_NAME LIKE '%合计%' AND b.PERIODDATE = '2024-12-31' AND b.RPT_TYPE = '合并' AND b.ISVALID=1
WHERE
    a.SEC_CSNAME LIKE '%万华化学%'
    AND a.END_DATE = '2024-12-31'
    AND (a.REVENUE_ASIA_CNY IS NOT NULL OR
         a.REVENUE_OCEANIA_CNY IS NOT NULL OR
         a.REVENUE_EU_CNY IS NOT NULL OR
         a.REVENUE_NON_EU_CNY IS NOT NULL OR
         a.REVENUE_AFRICA_CNY IS NOT NULL OR
         a.REVENUE_MID_EAST_CNY IS NOT NULL OR
         a.REVENUE_LATIN_AMERICA_CNY IS NOT NULL OR
         a.REVENUE_NORTH_AMERICA_CNY IS NOT NULL OR
         a.REVENUE_AMERICA_CNY IS NOT NULL OR
         a.REVENUE_JAPAN_CNY IS NOT NULL OR
         a.REVENUE_KOREA_CNY IS NOT NULL OR
         a.REVENUE_TW_CNY IS NOT NULL OR
         a.REVENUE_RUSSIA_CNY IS NOT NULL)
    AND a.COMB_SYMBOL IS NOT NULL
